Name: Fishing Bait Gate
Author: KenSauce
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Fishing Bait Gate makes bait matter again. Without any bait equipped on your fishing rod, you can only catch a handful of common starter fish: Sardine, Anchovy, and Smallmouth Bass. Equip any bait and the full vanilla fish pool opens back up. Junk, trash, and other non-fish catches are untouched.[/b][/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]1. Install the latest version of SMAPI[/b]
[b]2. Download this mod and unzip it into your Mods folder[/b]
[b]3. Run the game using SMAPI[/b][/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]- Restricts catchable fish to Sardine, Anchovy, and Smallmouth Bass when no bait is equipped[/b]
[b]- Any bait type unlocks the full fish pool immediately[/b]
[b]- Optional: replaces your starting Bamboo Pole with a Fiberglass Rod on day 1[/b]
[b]- Fully configurable via Generic Mod Config Menu if installed[/b][/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]- SMAPI 4.0.0 or later[/b]
[b]- Generic Mod Config Menu (optional, for in-game settings)[/b][/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Mod idea originally requested on the StardewModders/mod-ideas GitHub repository (issue #188).[/b][/color]
